**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Privacy
- **One-time question about anonymous usage statistics.** If you set up WhisperShortcut before 8.30, you never saw the new opt-in. The next time you open Settings or Chat, the app asks once. Counts only (how often a feature is used, whether it worked), never your words, audio, or which apps you use. "No Thanks" sends nothing, and you can change it anytime in Settings → Privacy & Permissions.

## Under the hood
- Updated the swift-collections dependency to 1.7.1.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.30...v8.31
